name: Rule grant fully overridden by same-policy Deny -> blocked-by-deny edge, dropped from table
note: Allow ec2:TerminateInstances on a concrete instance, with an unconditional same-policy Deny of the same action on the same resource. rules.js still EMITS the DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION capability finding (it is not Deny-aware), so graph.js can apply AWS explicit-Deny precedence and draw the can-destroy edge as blocked-by-deny, not confirmed-by-policy. But the AUTHORITATIVE FINDINGS TABLE drops the finding: an explicit Deny that fully covers the granted action removes the capability, so analyze() must not list it as a live risk (IAM-302; consistent with the frozen negative corpus explicit-deny-suppresses-exfil). The graph still shows the blocked edge; the table shows only live capabilities. Overstating a fully-denied grant as a table finding, or the edge as confirmed, would be a truthfulness harm (threat-model T8).
